title: Crawl lane gaps: softlock-solver latency and invisible deep-crawl truncation
body:
Two related crawl-lane facts worth a deliberate decision:

1. crawl:smoke sets solverBudget=0 (src/crawl/run.ts:219), so the quest softlock SOLVER runs only in nightly crawl:deep (20,000 states). Smoke still catches zero-legal-action hard locks and the overworld round-trip solver stays on (60k, run.ts:40), but softlock-by-unreachable-ending has ~24h detection latency and never blocks a PR. Either budget a small solver pass into smoke (measure the wall-clock cost first) or record the latency as accepted.

2. A deep crawl that hits the 900s soft cutoff sets truncated/skippedItems loudly in artifacts (run.ts:102-108) but still exits 0 with no findings (bin/crawl.ts:91-96) — invisible to the workflow's pass/fail. Fine for an advisory lane; if deep is ever promoted to required, truncation must gate or the promotion is partly theater. A --fail-on-truncation flag the deep-audit workflow could adopt would make that future promotion honest.

From the 2026-08-30 full audit, findings ledger P3.

evidence.summary: 2026-08-30 audit: required lane runs no quest softlock solver; deep truncation exits 0
